name: Stack-based Octree Traversal with Direction Flipping
aliases: Octree Ray Traversal with Direction Flipping
definition: A stack-based algorithm for traversing an octree structure along a ray, handling arbitrary ray directions by flipping the coordinate system and ray parameters to ensure positive traversal direction.
summary: Stack-based Octree Traversal with Direction Flipping uses an explicit stack and coordinate flipping to manage arbitrary ray directions and simplify child selection logic.
